item.title: Vietnamese Ambassador "I'm a Korean-American from a Small Town" ... US Asian Diplomacy That Has Become Almost Korean (베트남 대사 “나는 작은 마을의 한국계”… 한국판 돼 버린 美 아시아 외교)
item.description:
Vietnamese Ambassador "I'm a Korean-American from a Small Town" ... US Asian Diplomacy That Has Become Almost Korean (베트남 대사 “나는 작은 마을의 한국계”… 한국판 돼 버린 美 아시아 외교)

"I'm a Korean-American from a small town in Minnesota. It's a special place with over 1,000 lakes, and my parents still live there." (“나는 미네소타 작은 마을에서 온 한국계입니다. 호수가 1000개가 넘는 특별한 곳이고, 지금도 부모님이 거기 살고 계시지요.”)

Jennifer Weeks, the new U.S. Ambassador to Vietnam who took office last month, revealed her Korean-American background in a video posted on the embassy's official social media account. Weeks was confirmed by Congress in May and officially began her term on the 6th of last month after presenting her credentials to Vietnamese President To Lam. She is the ninth U.S. ambassador to Vietnam since the two countries normalized diplomatic relations in 1995, and the first woman to hold the post. Her Korean-American background was not widely known even within the State Department, and the video reportedly sparked considerable discussion in diplomatic circles at the time of its release. (지난달 부임한 제니퍼 윅스 베트남 주재 미국 대사가 최근 대사관 소셜미디어 공식 계정에 올린 영상에서 자신의 한국계 배경을 밝혔다. 윅스는 5월 의회 인준을 받았고, 지난달 6일 또 럼 베트남 국가주석에게 신임장을 제출하며 본격적인 임기를 시작했다. 1995년 미국과 베트남이 국교를 정상화한 이후 부임한 아홉 번째 대사이자 최초의 여성 주베트남 미국대사다. 그간 국무부 안팎에서도 윅스의 한국계 배경이 잘 알려져 있지 않아 영상 공개 당시 외교가에서 적잖은 화제가 된 것으로 알려졌다.)

The first Korean-American woman to serve as a U.S. ambassador was Yuri Kim, who became ambassador to Albania in 2020. Weeks is the third, following Julie Chung in Sri Lanka, and shortly after Weeks officially took office, former Republican Congresswoman Michelle Steel (Korean name: Park Eun-ju) arrived in Seoul to begin her work. Weeks began her career at the U.S. Department of the Army, with her first posting at Yongsan Garrison in Seoul. She later worked in Hawaii and at Fort Belvoir in Virginia, then joined the State Department in 2003 handling administrative affairs. Notably, from 2012, she served as director of the Presidential Personnel Office, overseeing the nomination process for more than 1,000 senior State Department officials. She maintained her position through four administrations—Obama, Biden, and Trump's first and second terms. She is regarded as a specialist in organizational and personnel matters rather than traditional bilateral diplomacy. (한국계 여성이 미국 대사를 지낸 건 2020년 유리 김 당시 알바니아 대사가 처음이었다. 윅스는 줄리 정 스리랑카 대사에 이어 세 번째고, 그가 정식으로 부임한 직후 미셸 스틸 전 공화당 하원의원(한국 이름 박은주)이 서울에 도착해 업무를 시작했다. 윅스는 미 육군부에서 커리어를 시작했는데 서울 용산기지가 첫 직장이었다. 이후 하와이, 버지니아주(州) 포트 벨보어에서 일했고 2003년 국무부에 입부해 행정 업무를 담당했다. 특히 2012년부터 대통령 인사실 책임자로 있으면서 1000명이 넘는 국무부 고위직 지명 절차를 총괄했다. 오바마·바이든, 트럼프 1·2기 등 4개 정부를 거치면서도 자리를 지켰다. 전통적인 양자(兩者) 외교보다는 조직·인사 등에 더 전문성이 있는 인물로 꼽힌다.)

At her Senate Foreign Relations Committee confirmation hearing in December of last year, Weeks also said, "I'm a girl from the Midwest," adding, "Growing up in Minnesota with parents who were public school teachers, I learned the values of hard work and service." She continued, "Since 2012, I have managed the nominations of 1,000 candidates for State Department leadership positions requiring Senate advice and consent and presidential appointment," and said, "It is a great honor to stand before you today as the nominee." Vietnam's importance has grown as one of America's key partners in the Indo-Pacific region amid great-power competition with China. Weeks stated, "The President and the Secretary of State clearly recognize the geopolitical and strategic importance of the Indo-Pacific region," and "Vietnam is one of America's most important partners in the region. I will advocate for U.S. national interests as the top priority within a vibrant bilateral relationship, focusing on defense and security cooperation, trade and investment, and people-to-people exchanges." (윅스는 지난해 12월 상원 외교위 인사청문회에서도 “나는 중서부 출신의 소녀”라며 “미네소타에서 공립학교 교사이신 부모님 밑에서 자라며 근면함과 봉사의 가치를 배웠다”고 했다. 이어 “2012년부터 국무부에서 상원의 자문·동의, 대통령 임명이 필요한 국무부 지도부 직책 후보자 1000명을 지명하는 업무를 수행했다”며 “오늘 이 자리에서 여러분 앞에 ‘상대편’으로 서게 된 것은 큰 영광”이라고 했다. 베트남은 중국과의 패권 경쟁 속 미국의 인도·태평양 지역 우방국 중 하나로 그 중요성이 커지고 있다. 윅스는 “대통령, 국무장관은 인·태 지역의 지정학적·전략적 중요성을 분명히 인식하고 있다”며 “베트남은 이 지역에서 미국의 가장 중요한 파트너 중 하나다. 국방·안보 협력, 무역·투자, 인절 교류에 중점을 두고 활기찬 양자 관계 속에서 국익을 최우선으로 옹호할 것”이라고 했다.)

Looking at recent U.S. diplomacy toward Asia, the rise of Korean-Americans is so prominent that it is hard to discuss without mentioning them. A prime example is Steel, who said upon arrival on the 30th of last month in Korean, "I was born in Seoul, but I stand here representing the United States" and "Standing here again, I am filled with mixed emotions." At the U.S. Mission to ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) in Jakarta, Indonesia, Kevin Kim has taken office as ambassador and will accompany President Donald Trump on his visit to the Philippines (the chair country) in November. Kim's father is Kim Won-yong, a former professor at Ewha Womans University. However, opinions are divided on whether such Korean-American backgrounds are a "plus" factor in bilateral relations, as some apply even stricter standards depending on the case. Michael DeSombre, the Deputy Assistant Secretary for East Asian and Pacific Affairs, who oversees U.S. diplomatic policy for the Asia-Pacific region including Korea, has a Korean spouse. (최근 미국의 대(對)아시아 외교를 보면 ‘한국계’를 빼놓고는 얘기가 되지 않을 정도로 한국계 약진이 두드러지고 있다. 지난달 30일 “서울에서 태어났지만 미국을 대표해 이 자리에 섰다” “이 자리에 다시 서니 만감이 교차한다”고 입국 소감을 한국어로 밝힌 스틸이 대표적이다. 인도네시아 자카르타의 아세안(ASEAN·동남아시아국가연합) 대표부에는 케빈 김이 대사로 부임해 11월 있을 도널드 트럼프 대통령의 필리핀(의장국) 방문을 수행하게 된다. 김씨의 부친은 김원용 전 이화여대 교수다. 다만 이런 한국계 배경들이 양자 관계에 ‘플러스’ 요인이냐를 놓고는 의견이 엇갈린다. 경우에 따라 더 까다로운 잣대를 들이대는 이들도 적지 않기 때문이다. 한국을 포함한 아시아·태평양 지역의 미 외교 정책 실무를 총괄하는 마이클 디솜브레 동·아태 차관보는 배우자가 한국계다.)

item.title: The Hubbard Failure That US Ambassador Steel Must Remember (스틸 美대사가 새겨야 할 허바드의 실패)
item.description:
The Hubbard Failure That US Ambassador Steel Must Remember (스틸 美대사가 새겨야 할 허바드의 실패)

With US Ambassador to Korea Michelle Steel arriving in Seoul a few days ago, the vacancy in the ambassadorial post that had persisted for over a year and a half has finally been resolved. Attention now turns to the footsteps of someone carrying the symbolic weight of being the "first Korean-American female US ambassador to Korea." Ambassador Steel served in the US House of Representatives, speaking out clearly on issues such as the North Korean nuclear problem, the ROK-US alliance, and China's forced repatriation of North Korean defectors. Her husband, attorney Sean Steel, is a prominent figure in the US Republican Party, and the Steel couple is said to have close communication lines with President Trump. <<> Yet success as a US ambassador in Korea is not determined by these factors alone. Since some left-wing factions opposed to the ROK-US alliance can amplify anti-American sentiment politically at any time, what matters is how well the ambassador reads the sentiments of Korean society and navigates unexpected political waves. It is no exaggeration to say that the ambassador's success or failure hinges on swift political judgment in times of crisis. <<> The nine US ambassadors to Korea since 1999 <<> After working as a social affairs reporter and being assigned to the political desk in 1999, I covered and observed nine US ambassadors to Korea up close. They are Stephen Bosworth, Thomas Hubbard, Christopher Hill, Alexander Vershbow, Kathleen Stephens, Sung Kim, Mark Lippert, Harry Harris, and Philip Goldberg. <<> Bosworth received relatively high marks among Korean diplomats, and after leaving his post in February 2001, he served as special representative for North Korea policy in the Obama administration. He passed away relatively early in 2016 at the age of 77. <<> Christopher Hill opened an internet forum called "Cafe USA" to initiate direct dialogue with the Korean public for the first time, leaving a fresh impression. As the first US ambassador to Korea to engage the public in a popular manner, he was later promoted to Assistant Secretary of State and served as the chief negotiator in the Six-Party Talks on the North Korean nuclear issue. <<> Kathleen Stephens, a former Peace Corps volunteer who worked at Yesan Middle School in South Chungcheong Province, stood out in the field of "public diplomacy" based on her excellent Korean language skills and understanding of Korean culture. Ambassador Sung Kim made good use of his advantage as the first Korean-American US ambassador. He contributed to developing ROK-US relations while maintaining a positive image in Korean society externally. <<> Ambassador Mark Lippert, remembered as a passionate fan of the Doosan Bears baseball team, is etched in memory as an ambassador who emphasized his love for the ROK-US alliance and Korea even after surviving a horrific attack in 2015. <<> On the other hand, if asked which ambassador endured a rough period by colliding head-on with anti-American sentiment in Korean society, it would undoubtedly be Ambassador Thomas Hubbard. Ambassador Alexander Vershbow also had a difficult time during the 2008 candlelight protests over US beef led by the left wing, but not to the same extent as Ambassador Hubbard. <<> East Asia expert Ambassador Hubbard <<> Hubbard, who served as US ambassador to Korea from July 2001 to July 2004, was a leading East Asia expert at the US State Department. He was an experienced and seasoned diplomat. He dealt extensively with East Asian affairs, including Korea and Japan, at the State Department, and came to Korea after serving as ambassador to the Philippines. He was also involved in the Geneva Agreed Framework and was regarded as having a good understanding of Korean affairs. In Washington, he arrived with expectations of being "the most suitable diplomat for Seoul." <<> His tenure overlapped with the conservative George W. Bush administration and the progressive governments of Kim Dae-jung and Roh Moo-hyun. In the United States, a "war of retaliation" began following the 9/11 attacks, and North Korea returned to the center of the nuclear issue amid suspicions over its highly enriched uranium (HEU) program. The ROK-US alliance was also facing a new test as successive progressive governments took office. <<> Against this backdrop, a tragic incident occurred: the Hyosun and Miseon case on June 13, 2002, in Yangju, Gyeonggi Province. An armored vehicle from the US 2nd Infantry Division, on a training exercise, struck and killed middle school students Shin Hyo-sun and Shim Mi-seon on a narrow road. It was a tragedy that should never have happened under any circumstances. It was also partly the result of a failure to properly train US forces in Korea to exercise extreme caution when conducting training outside their camps. <<> Yet immediately after the accident, Korean society did not treat it with the gravity it deserved. The entire country was caught up in World Cup fever. Waves of Red Devils cheering filled the streets, and public attention was focused on the national soccer team's performance. The deaths of two young schoolgirls at the hands of a US military armored vehicle were reported immediately, but they did not quickly escalate into large-scale anti-American protests. <<> The US thought only in legal terms <<> The US Embassy and US Forces Korea did not treat the incident lightly. Ambassador Hubbard expressed regret on several occasions immediately after the accident and stated a commitment to prevent a recurrence. But that was where it ended. <<> Ambassador Hubbard and General Leon LaPorte, commander of US Forces Korea, judged that while the accident itself was deeply unfortunate, it could be sufficiently resolved through legal procedures. They emphasized that since US soldiers were performing their duties during training, it was legally justifiable for the US to exercise jurisdiction under the ROK-US Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA). Accordingly, the US military did not hand over the driver and the track commander responsible for the incident to Korean authorities. From the US perspective, it was a procedure in accordance with the agreement. But many Koreans saw it as disregarding Korea's judicial sovereignty. <<> The US, which stations troops in more than 50 countries around the world, surely could not ignore precedent. Even so, it should have anticipated the repercussions this incident would have on Korean politics and society. The US insisted on resolving the issue at a legal level, but Korea is a country where "legal mindset" remains weak. There is still a culture that questions whether even a legal apology carries sincerity. <<> The US should have kept in mind the Yoon Geum-i case that occurred 10 years before this incident, in 1992, but it failed to do so. In October 1992, in Dongducheon, Gyeonggi Province, a woman named Yoon Geum-i working in a camp town was brutally murdered by a US soldier stationed in Korea. Private Kenneth Lee Markle was apprehended after the crime, and when the horrifying details of the killing became known, it ignited public outrage nationwide. The Yoon Geum-i case became a catalyst for demands regarding US military crimes and the need to revise the SOFA. Voices calling for strict punishment of US military offenses and SOFA revision spread across the country, led by civic and women's organizations. At the time of the Hyo-sun and Mi-seon incident in 2002, officials on both the Korean and US sides failed to pay attention to the possibility that the case could become a political issue in the run-up to the 16th presidential election. <<> The 'not guilty verdict' just before the presidential election <<> As the cold winds began to blow in 2002, the Roh Moo-hyun campaign and the left-wing camp started focusing on the public grief and anger surrounding the deaths of the two middle school girls. The decisive moment in this crisis came in November 2002. The US military court martial acquitted the armored vehicle driver and the track commander in succession. The verdict came as a result of a jury of seven US military members returning a not-guilty finding. And they immediately left the country. For the US, it was a legal judgment related to the performance of official duties, but it was received as an entirely different message by Korean society. The perception that "two middle school girls died and no one is taking responsibility" spread rapidly. <<> Citizens holding candles began to gather in downtown Seoul, including Gwanghwamun. What started as rallies centered on students and civic groups gradually spread nationwide, and the anti-American protests emerged as one of the biggest variables in Korean politics ahead of the December presidential election. Ambassador Hubbard belatedly realized the seriousness of the situation. He acknowledged this in a 2012 interview with the Chosun Ilbo, ten years after the incident. <<> "Neither I nor the White House truly understood that Koreans and Americans have fundamentally different frameworks for accepting an 'apology.' We failed to understand Korean culture, where when something terrible happens, someone must take responsibility by being legally punished or resigning." <<> <The second part continues next week> (미셸 스틸 주한 미국대사가 며칠 전 서울에 부임하면서 1년 6개월 넘게 이어졌던 주한 미국대사 공백 사태가 마침내 해소됐습니다. 이제는 ‘한국계 최초의 여성 주한 미국대사’라는 상징성을 가진 그의 행보에 관심이 쏠리고 있습니다. 스틸 대사는 미국 연방하원의원을 지내며 북한 핵 문제와 한미동맹, 중국의 탈북민 강제북송 등에 대해 분명한 목소리를 내온 인물입니다. 남편 숀 스틸 변호사가 미 공화당의 유력 인사로 스틸 부부는 트럼프 대통령과 긴밀한 소통이 가능하다는 평가를 받습니다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min's 'Inevitable Failure' Theory Sparks... "Already a Psychological Party Split" in the Democratic Party (유시민이 쏘아 올린 '필패론'…민주당서 "이미 심리적 분당")
item.description:
Yoo Si-min's 'Inevitable Failure' Theory Sparks... "Already a Psychological Party Split" in the Democratic Party (유시민이 쏘아 올린 '필패론'…민주당서 "이미 심리적 분당" )

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, the figure drawing the most spotlight in the progressive camp is neither a party leader candidate nor President Lee Jae-myung. It's author Yoo Si-min, who is pouring out political remarks day after day across broadcasts and YouTube. After a major election passes, even the most influential commentator's message typically loses its power, but this time is different. Yoo, who had previously emphasized unity and solidarity within the Democratic Party camp, is now voluntarily leading the charge in "progressive division." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 진보 진영에서 가장 큰 스포트라이트를 받는 인물은 당대표 후보도, 이재명 대통령도 아니다. 방송과 유튜브를 넘나들며 연일 정치적 발언을 쏟아내는 유시민 작가다. 큰 선거가 지나고 난 뒤에는 제아무리 영향력 있는 평론가라도 메시지의 힘이 떨어지기 마련인데 이번엔 다르다. 그간 민주당 진영의 일치와 단결을 강조해왔던 유 작가가 자처해서 ‘진보 분열’에 앞장서는 분위기다.)

Yoo stepped down from his position as standing adviser to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation on June 15, after the local elections, signaling his future critical activities. It was, in effect, a declaration of his return to political commentary. He had already been providing rear support during the local election period by appearing on Kim Eo-joon's shows, but why he would give up his title for the sake of full-fledged political commentary remained a question. Moreover, it was difficult to gauge the ripple effects his moves would have on the entire opposition camp. (유 작가는 지방선거 이후인 지난 6월 15일 노무현재단 상임고문직에서 물러나면서 향후 비평 활동을 예고했다. 사실상의 정치평론 복귀를 선언한 것이다. 그는 이미 지방선거 기간 김어준씨 방송 등에 출연해 후방지원을 이어왔지만, 본격적인 정치평론을 이유로 직함까지 내려놓은 이유는 의문이었다. 또 그의 행보가 여권 전체에 일으킬 파장은 가늠하기도 어려웠다.)

Yoo began openly criticizing President Lee Jae-myung on every broadcast appearance. He raised the intensity of his criticism not only on issues like the government's supplementary investigation powers—the so-called "prosecution reform"—but also on President Lee's centrist and pragmatic line. His remarks, such as "President Lee is heading down a path of inevitable failure" or "Even a fishmonger selling the finest quality fish can tolerate a fishy smell, but it can't go rotten," sent shockwaves through the entire progressive camp. Even a staff member from a lawmaker's office affiliated with the pro-Chung (pro-Chung Cheong-rae) faction expressed, "Everyone was so surprised, thinking, 'Why is he doing that?'" (유 작가는 방송에 출연할 때마다 이재명 대통령을 공개적으로 비판하기 시작했다. 그는 정부의 보완수사권 등 이른바 ‘검찰개혁’ 문제를 포함해 이 대통령의 중도·실용 노선에 대해서도 비판 수위를 높였는데, “이 대통령이 필연적인 실패의 길로 가고 있다”라거나 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 갖다 파는 어물전도 비린내까지는 괜찮지만 썩은내로 가면 안 된다” 등의 발언은 진보 진영 전체에 충격을 줬다. 친청(친정청래)계로 분류되는 민주당 의원실 관계자조차 “모두 놀라서 ‘왜 저러나’ 생각이 든다”고 표현할 정도였다.)

The problem isn't just the intensity of his remarks. Having lived as the progressive camp's "representative speaker" for over 20 years since the participatory government era, Yoo had rarely criticized the government and ruling party during the tenure of a Democratic Party president. That's what has changed now. He has begun directly attacking President Lee during the (문제는 발언 수위뿐만이 아니다. 참여정부 시절부터 20년 넘게 진보 진영 ‘대표 스피커’로 살아온 유 작가는 그간 민주당 대통령이 재임하던 시절 좀처럼 정부·여당에 대해 비판하지 않았다. 그랬던 그가 달라진 것이다. 민주당 정부)

first year of the Democratic Party government, and at a time when it holds overwhelming power, including in the National Assembly. This is a stark departure from his behavior during the Moon Jae-in administration, when he defended the administration so fiercely that he described himself as a "progressive government-friendly intellectual." (1년 차, 그것도 의회를 포함해 압도적 권력을 유지하고 있는 시기에 이 대통령을 정면으로 공격하기 시작했다. 문재인 정부 시절 스스로를 ‘진보 어용 지식인’이라고 표현할 정도로 정권을 방어했던 모습과는 차원이 달라졌다.)

Inside and outside the Democratic Party, opinions are divided over Yoo's intentions. Some interpret his actions as dreaming, in the short term, of Chung Cheong-rae's victory in the convention and a win for the pro-Chung faction, and in the long term, of the revival of the pro-Moon (pro-Moon Jae-in) and pro-Roh (pro-Roh Moo-hyun) factions. However, a Democratic Party official said this: "When President Lee Jae-myung was elected, he said, 'We need to expand toward the center,' and then just (민주당 안팎에서는 유 작가의 의도에 대해 의견이 분분하다. 짧게는 전당대회에서 정청래 후보의 당선과 ‘친청’의 승리를, 길게는 친문(친문재인계)·친노(친노무현계)의 부활을 꿈꾼다는 해석도 있다. 그러나 민주당 관계자는 이렇게 말한다. “이재명 대통령이 당선될 때만 해도 ‘중도 확장해야 한다’고 말하고서, 고작)

one year later, it's 'We are the real ones, you are the fake ones'—that's the core issue." The point is that this goes beyond criticizing a first-year president and instead divides the camp into factions. (1년 만에 ‘우리는 진짜, 너희는 가짜’라고 하는 것이 핵심이다.” 집권 1년 차 대통령에 대한 비판을 넘어 세력을 가른다는 점에 주목할 필요가 있다는 것이다.)

"For the Sake of the Lee Administration"... A Tribute to Roh? (“李정부 위해서”… 盧에게 바치는 헌정? )

Yoo has repeatedly emphasized that his recent criticisms are "a sincere appeal for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." So why is he leveling such harsh criticism? (유 작가는 최근 자신의 비판에 대해 “이재명 정부의 성공을 위한 충정”이라고 거듭 강조한다. 그런 그가 강도 높은 비판을 하는 이유는 무엇일까.)

First, it can be linked to the unfinished task of "prosecution reform," which has fallen short of expectations since President Lee took office. Kim Cheol-hyun, a special professor at Kyungil University, explained, "Yoo's recent remarks ultimately resemble a kind of tribute to Roh Moo-hyun," adding, "There's a strong sense of the conviction that the Lee Jae-myung administration must complete the reforms that the Roh Moo-hyun government failed to achieve." Through the death of former President Roh Moo-hyun and the prosecution reform controversies during the Moon Jae-in administration, reducing prosecutorial powers, separating investigation and indictment, and reforming power institutions have become long-cherished tasks within the progressive camp, going beyond mere policy. Yoo has also been one of the most vocal figures advocating for prosecution reform throughout that process. (우선 이 대통령 취임 이후 기대에 미치지 못하는 ‘검찰개혁’이라는 미완의 과제와 연결하기도 한다. 김철현 경일대 특임교수는 “(유 작가의) 최근 발언은 결국 노무현에게 바치는 일종의 헌정처럼 보인다”면서 “노무현 정부에서 이루지 못했던 개혁을 이재명 정부가 완성해야 한다는 문제의식이 강하게 반영돼 있다”고 설명했다. 노무현 전 대통령의 서거와 문재인 정부 시절의 검찰개혁 논란을 거치며 민주 진영 내부에서는 검찰 권한 축소와 수사·기소 분리, 권력기관 개혁이 단순한 정책을 넘어 숙원 과제로 자리 잡았다. 유 작가 역시 그 과정에서 누구보다 강하게 검찰개혁을 주장해 온 대표적 인물이기도 하다.)

However, within the party, there is a sense that Yoo has gone too far. A senior official at the party's central headquarters said, "There's no disagreement on the direction of prosecution reform, but the pace and method are matters for the president and government to judge comprehensively," adding, "Isn't it too hasty to say from the very start of the administration that 'the president's will or thinking (on prosecution reform) has changed'?" He further added, "It just looks like he's using the supplementary investigation powers issue to square off against the president ahead of the national convention." (그러나 당내에서는 유 작가가 과하다는 분위기도 감지된다. 한 민주당 중앙당 관계자는 “검찰개혁의 방향성에는 이견이 없지만, 속도와 방식은 대통령과 정부가 종합적으로 판단할 문제”라며 “집권 초부터 ‘대통령의 (검찰개혁에 대한) 의지나 생각이 바뀌었다’고 말하는 것은 너무 섣부른 것 아니냐”고 말했다. 이어 “전당대회를 위해 보완수사권을 띄우고 대통령한테 각을 세우는 것으로밖에 안 보인다”고 덧붙였다.)

Professor Kim also offered this assessment: "Yoo's emotions seem to be running too far ahead at times. It's a kind of 'grudge-settling politics.' Using the phrase 'inevitable failure' immediately after the supplementary investigation powers controversy erupted goes beyond policy criticism and risks being seen as political slander." (김 교수 역시 이렇게 평가했다. “(유 작가의) 감정이 지나치게 앞서는 모습도 있다. 일종의 ‘한풀이 정치’인 것이다. 보완수사권 논란이 불거지자마자 곧바로 ‘필연적 실패’라는 표현까지 사용한 것은 정책 비판을 넘어 정치적 악담으로 받아들여질 소지가 있다.”)

There are also interpretations that Yoo's moves are aimed at reviving the pro-Moon and pro-Roh factions. A staff member from a pro-Lee faction lawmaker's office interpreted, "In the end, isn't he dreaming of reviving the pro-Moon forces by putting Chung Cheong-rae at the forefront? Kim Eo-joon and Yoo Si-min have already shown this before the convention." Earlier, starting in early March, before the local elections, Yoo had argued for the so-called "ABC theory." After the elections, Yoo proposed the "expansion theory" and the "rebuilding theory," while Kim Eo-joon raised the "core support base defection theory." The earlier Democratic Party central headquarters official also said, "In the end, one could see it as thinking about 'the revival of the pro-Moon faction.'" (유 작가의 행보에 대해 친문·친노의 부활을 염두에 둔 것이라는 해석도 있다. 한 친명계 의원실 관계자는 “결국 정청래를 앞세워 친문 세력의 부활을 꿈꾸는 것 아니겠느냐”며 “이미 전당대회 전부터 김어준과 유시민이 보여줬다”고 해석했다. 앞서 유 작가는 지방선거 이전인 지난 3월 초부터 이른바 ‘ABC론’을 주장한 바 있다. 선거 이후 유 작가는 ‘증축론·재건축론’을, 김어준씨는 ‘코어 지지층 이탈설’을 제기하기도 했다. 앞서 민주당 중앙당 관계자 역시 “결국 ‘친문의 부활’을 생각할 수도 있다고 본다”고 말했다.)

"Regardless of Intent"... Already a Psychological Party Split? (“의도가 어떠하든”… 이미 심리적 분당?)

Apart from Yoo's stated intention of "for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration," the rift between the Democratic Party and its support base appears to be deepening. The current shape of the national convention reflects this. A staff member from Kim Min-seok's campaign said, "Regardless of what Yoo's intent is, during the five years of the Moon Jae-in administration, did anyone within the Democratic Party shake things up or evaluate the government this openly?" adding, "Right now, this is President Lee's time, and it sounds less like advice or guidance and more like a curse." (“이재명 정부의 성공을 위해서”라는 유 작가의 의도와는 별개로 민주당과 지지층이 겪는 갈등의 골은 깊어지는 모양새다. 당장 전당대회 양상이 그렇다. 김민석 후보 캠프 관계자는 “(유 작가의 의도가 무엇이든) 문재인 정부 5년 동안 민주당 내부에서 이렇게 공개적으로 흔들거나 평가했느냐”며 “지금은 결국 이 대통령의 시간인데, 훈수나 조언을 넘어 거의 저주에 가까운 이야기처럼 들린다”고 말했다.)

Amid voices of concern within the party, talk of a "party split" is cautiously leaking out. A Democratic Party official said, "With the supplementary investigation powers already adopted as party policy, if President Lee were to exercise a veto, then we would genuinely have to consider a split," adding, "Within the party, the expression 'a psychological split has already occurred' is now being spoken openly." (당내에서도 우려의 목소리가 나오는 가운데, 조심스럽게 ‘분당’ 이야기도 새어나오고 있다. 민주당 관계자는 “보완수사권이 이미 당론으로 채택된 마당에 이재명 대통령이 거부권이라도 행사한다면, 그때는 정말 분당까지도 생각해야 할 것”이라며 “이미 당 안에서는 ‘심리적 분당이 됐다’는 표현까지 공공연하게 나온다”고 말했다.)

Of course, the likelihood of the Democratic Party actually proceeding with a formal split after the convention is low. However, with the public noise of a "Myung-Chung War" beginning already in the early days of the administration, and with a symbolic figure like Yoo Si-min also raising the intensity of his criticism, the prevailing view is that internal fractures will not be easily mended. (물론 전당대회 이후 민주당이 실제 분당 수순을 밟을 가능성은 크지 않다. 다만 집권 초반부터 ‘명청대전’이라는 공개적 잡음이 들리기 시작했고, 여기에 더해 유시민이라는 상징적 인물조차 비판 수위를 높이면서 당내 균열이 쉽게 봉합되기는 어려울 것이라는 전망이 지배적이다.)

Some are also pointing out the attitude of the pro-Moon and pro-Roh forces toward President Lee. The analysis is that the traditional mainstream forces, which had been held together under the name of Lee Jae-myung to win the presidential election, are gradually revealing their true stripes. A party official asked rhetorically, "Until recently, I thought President Lee Jae-myung had overwhelming charisma since his time as party leader, but perhaps that wasn't the case after all," and added, "It seems it was just a coalition of convenience because there was no one else who could win the presidential election and become president." (일각에서는 이 대통령에 대한 친문·친노 세력의 태도를 지적하는 목소리도 나온다. 대선 승리를 위해 이재명이라는 이름 아래 묶여 있던 전통적 주류 세력이 서서히 노선을 드러낸다는 분석이다. 한 민주당 당직자는 “얼마 전까지는 이재명 대통령이 대표 시절부터 압도적 카리스마를 갖고 있다고 생각했는데, 알고 보니 그게 아니었던 것은 아닐까”라고 반문하며 “단순히 대선을 이기고 대통령 될 사람이 없었기 때문에 이뤄진 이합집산이었던 것 같다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Jung Jeom-sik "Government Driving Stock Market into 'Bungee Jump KOSPI'... Proposes Parliamentary Investigation to Ruling Party" (정점식 “정부 주식시장 ‘번지점프 국장’ 몰이...與에 국정조사 제안”)
item.description:
Jung Jeom-sik "Government Driving Stock Market into 'Bungee Jump KOSPI'... Proposes Parliamentary Investigation to Ruling Party" (정점식 “정부 주식시장 ‘번지점프 국장’ 몰이...與에 국정조사 제안”)

People Power Party floor leader Jung Jeom-sik said on the 2nd, addressing the Democratic Party of Korea, "I propose a parliamentary investigation to determine responsibility for the crisis in the KOSPI and KOSDAQ stock markets." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 2일 더불어민주당을 향해 “코스피·코스닥 주식시장 대란의 책임 규명을 위한 국정조사를 제안한다”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Jung said, "Our stock market is currently abnormal," and "It is time for the National Assembly to step up to swiftly identify the causes and responsibility for the current situation and to promote the healthy development of the stock market." He cited five key issues that should be examined through the parliamentary investigation: the process of introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs and their aftermath, the government's actions encouraging stock market overheating that have continued since last year, government-induced disruptive factors that have increased market uncertainty—such as the controversy over corporate excess profit distribution and the creation of the Honam semiconductor cluster—the trends and appropriateness of domestic stock investment by the National Pension Service and other pension funds over the past year, and the adequacy of the roles of financial supervisory authorities and economic policy departments. <<> Regarding the recent stock market, Jung said, "A 16.17% plunge in the KOSPI in just two days is not normal, and a 17.91% surge in a single day on Friday is also not normal." He added, "The scale of the KOSPI's decline in July was larger than during the IMF foreign exchange crisis," and "Circuit breakers and sidecars, which we'd be lucky to see once a year, have become routine." He went on to say, "We must carefully nurture the opportunity of the semiconductor boom that has finally come to South Korea," and "We need to develop the industry and use this opportunity to grow the nation's retirement funds and young people's assets." (정 원내대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “지금 우리 주식시장은 비정상”이라며 “작금의 상황이 빚어진 원인과 책임을 신속히 규명하고, 주식 시장의 건강한 발전을 위해 국회가 나서야 할 때”라며 이같이 제안했다. 정 원내대표는 국정조사를 통해 중점적으로 들여다봐야 하는 사안으로 단일종목 레버리지 ETF 도입 과정과 그 여파, 지난해부터 이어져 온 정부의 주식시장 과열 조장 행위, 기업 초과이윤 배분 논란·호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 등 시장의 불확실성을 키운 정부발(發) 교란 악재, 지난 1년간 국민연금 등 연기금의 국내 주식 투자 동향과 적절성, 금융감독 당국과 경제정책 부서 역할의 적정성 등 5가지를 꼽았다.)

Jung said, "The recent behavior of the government has been the exact opposite," and "It has driven the Korean stock market beyond a 'roller-coaster KOSPI' into a 'bungee jump KOSPI.'" He added, "They have turned the stock market into a casino-like gambling den," and "The bigger problem is whether the stability of pension funds, including the National Pension Service—the retirement funds of all citizens—has been properly protected in this process." He also said, "If the government's inappropriate intervention and policy failures have heightened stock market instability and caused large-scale evaporation of citizens' retirement funds, then severe accountability must be imposed." (정 원내대표는 최근 주식 시장에 대해 “코스피가 단 이틀 만에 16.17% 폭락한 것도 정상이 아니고, 금요일 하루에 17.91% 폭등한 것도 정상이 아니다”고 했다. 이어 “7월 한 달간 코스피 급락 폭은 IMF 외환위기 당시보다 컸다”며 “1년에 한 번 볼까 말까 한 서킷 브레이커와 사이드카가 일상이 돼 버렸다”고 했다. 그러면서 “우리는 대한민국에 간만에 불어온 반도체 호황의 기회를 소중히 가꿔나가야 한다”며 “산업을 발전시키고 이 기회에 국민 노후 자금과 청년들 자산도 키워나가야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: "In Last Year's Presidential Election, Some Polling Stations Showed Voter Counts Increasing by Exactly 100 Per Hour for 11 Consecutive Hours... Evidence of Manipulation" (주진우 “작년 대선 11시간 연속 투표자 수 시간당 100명 단위 증가한 곳도…조작 정황”)
item.description:
Joo Jin-woo: "In Last Year's Presidential Election, Some Polling Stations Showed Voter Counts Increasing by Exactly 100 Per Hour for 11 Consecutive Hours... Evidence of Manipulation" (주진우 “작년 대선 11시간 연속 투표자 수 시간당 100명 단위 증가한 곳도…조작 정황”)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo claimed on the 2nd that during last year's 21st presidential election, some polling stations showed voter counts increasing by exactly 100 at a time or not increasing at all for certain periods, raising suspicions of deliberate manipulation by the National Election Commission (NEC). (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 2일 지난해 제21대 대선 당시 일부 투표소에서 투표자 수가 정확히 100명씩 증가하거나 일정 시간 동안 한 명도 증가하지 않은 것으로 확인돼 선거관리위원회의 고의 조작이 의심된다고 주장했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly that day, Rep. Joo said, "In the 21st presidential election, the NEC deliberately manipulated voter turnout," and added, "At three polling stations in Hongeun 2-dong, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, voter counts were arbitrarily fabricated in increments of 100 per hour and falsely entered." He claimed that voter counts increased in units of 100 for 11 consecutive hours, such as 100 at 7 a.m., 100 at 8 a.m., 100 at 9 a.m., 200 at 10 a.m., 100 at 11 a.m., 200 at noon, and 200 at 1 p.m. He also said that in Uichang-gu, Changwon, voter counts increased by exactly 100 per hour for five consecutive hours from 7 a.m. to noon, and that "a total of five polling districts falsely entered voter counts cut off in units of 100 in this manner." (주 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “지난 21대 대선에서 선관위는 투표율을 고의로 조작했다”며 “서울 서대문구 홍은2동 투표소 3곳에서는 매시간 투표자 수를 100명 단위로 임의로 지어내 허위로 입력했다”고 했다. 오전 7시 100명, 8시 100명, 9시 100명, 10시 200명, 11시 100명, 12시 200명, 13시 200명 등 투표자 수가 11시간 연속 100명 단위로 증가했다는 것이다. 창원 의창구에서는 오전 7시부터 정오까지 5시간 연속으로 투표자 수가 정확히 100명씩만 증가한 것으로 확인됐다며 “이런 방식으로 100명 단위로 끊어 투표자 수를 부정 입력한 투표구가 총 5곳”이라고 했다.)

According to Rep. Joo, as many as 90 polling districts showed no increase in voter counts at all for certain periods. He said, "At Namchon 1st polling district in Osan, Gyeonggi Province, 259 voters were added in one hour, but not a single voter was added for the next three hours," and "there were also 14 polling districts where voter counts increased by only one or two for more than two consecutive hours." He added, "At Segok-dong 1st polling district in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, 292 voters were added in one hour, but only 2 voted in the following two hours." (주 의원에 따르면 일정 시간 동안 투표자 수가 단 한 명도 증가하지 않은 투표구도 90곳에 이른다. 주 의원은 “경기 오산시 남촌 1투표구에서는 1시간 동안 259명이 증가한 뒤 3시간 동안 단 한 명도 늘지 않았다”며 “2시간 이상 연속으로 투표자 수가 1명 또는 2명만 증가한 투표구도 14곳”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “서울 강남구 세곡동 1투표구에서는 한 시간 동안 292명이 증가한 직후 2시간 동안 단 2명만 투표했다”고 했다.)

Rep. Joo stated, "In the last presidential election, deliberate manipulation of voter counts was revealed at a total of 109 locations," and "The fact that voter counts were deliberately falsely entered into the server not only in this local election but also in the last presidential election indicates organized and habitual criminal behavior." He further said, "The NEC-led recount at Olympic Park (of ballot boxes) is an act of destroying evidence," and "The joint police-prosecution investigative headquarters must secure as much evidence as possible through prompt compulsory investigation until a special prosecutor is appointed, and the courts must not reject warrants in a way that protects their own." (주 의원은 “지난 대선에서 총 109곳에서 투표자 수를 고의 조작한 것이 드러났다”며 “이번 지방선거에 이어 지난 대선까지 투표자 수를 서버에 고의로 허위 입력한 것은 조직적·습관적인 범죄행위라는 뜻”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “선관위 위주의 올림픽공원 (투표함) 재검표는 증거인멸 행위”라며 “검경 합동수사본부는 특검이 발족할 때까지 신속한 강제수사로 증거를 최대한 확보해야 하고, 법원은 제 식구 감싸기식 영장 기각을 해선 안 된다”고 했다.)

After the press conference, Rep. Joo met with reporters and said, "Rather than conducting a recount at Olympic Park, I counter-propose to the Democratic Party that the NEC's computer servers be re-verified first through bipartisan agreement," adding, "The proper sequence is to verify the deliberately falsified data first, covering the last presidential election and general election." (주 의원은 기자회견 종료 후 취재진을 만나 “올림픽공원 재검표를 할 것이 아니라 선관위 전산 서버부터 여야 합의로 재검증할 것을 민주당에 역제안한다”며 “지난 대선과 총선에 이르기까지 고의로 데이터를 허위 입력한 부분부터 검증하는 것이 순서”라고 했다.)

item.title: Korean Prime Minister issues urgent directive for "cross-ministry heat wave response" (韓총리 “범부처 폭염 대응” 긴급 지시)
item.description:
Korean Prime Minister issues urgent directive for "cross-ministry heat wave response" (韓총리 “범부처 폭염 대응” 긴급 지시)

As heat waves continue across the country, Prime Minister Han Sung-sook on the 2nd directed relevant ministries to actively respond to the heat wave. (전국에서 폭염이 계속되자 한성숙 국무총리가 2일 관계 부처에 폭염에 적극적으로 대처하라고 지시했다.)

According to the Prime Minister's Office, Prime Minister Han issued the directive for emergency response to relevant ministries and local governments after the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters issued an Emergency Level 2 alert due to the heat wave and concerns arose over drought damage in some regions. (총리실에 따르면, 한 총리는 폭염으로 중앙재난안전대책본부가 비상 2단계를 발령하고 일부 지역에 가뭄 피해가 우려되자 관계 부처와 지방정부에 비상 대응을 지시했다.)

To the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, she said, "Inspect the implementation status of heat wave measures by relevant ministries and local governments, and actively coordinate and support so that cross-ministry heat wave responses can be carried out organically." (행정안전부에는 “관계 부처 및 지방정부의 폭염 대책 추진 상황을 점검하고, 범부처 폭염 대응이 유기적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 적극 조정·지원하라”고 했다.)

To each local government, she said, "Thoroughly inspect whether there are any issues with the operation of cooling shelters and heat wave mitigation facilities, and take immediate action on any matters requiring improvement." (각 지방정부에는 “무더위 쉼터와 폭염 저감 시설 운영에 문제가 없는지 철저히 점검하고, 보완이 필요한 사항은 즉시 조치하라”고 했다.)

To the Ministry of Health and Welfare, she said, "Inspect the operation status of air conditioning in senior citizen centers and shelters mainly used by heat wave-vulnerable groups such as elderly living alone and residents of temporary housing (jjokbang), and conduct regular check-in phone calls or visits." (보건복지부에는 “독거노인이나 쪽방 거주민 등 폭염 취약계층이 주로 이용하는 경로당과 쉼터의 냉방 가동 상황을 점검하고, 수시로 안부 전화나 방문을 실시하라”고 했다.)

To the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, she said, "As there are many cases of elderly farmers losing their lives while working outdoors, ensure that village broadcasts urging caution against outdoor work are actively conducted." She also said, "In cooperation with local governments, conduct on-site inspections of outdoor work by elderly farmers in vinyl greenhouses, rice paddies, and fields." (농림축산식품부에는 “고령의 농업인이 야외 작업을 하다가 목숨을 잃는 사례가 많은 만큼, 야외 작업을 당부하는 마을 방송이 적극적으로 실시되도록 하라”고 했다. 또 “지방정부와 협력해 비닐하우스, 논·밭 등에서의 고령 농업인 야외 작업에 대한 현장 점검을 실시하라”고 했다.)

To the Ministry of Employment and Labor, she said, "Inspect the actual conditions of whether the five basic heat wave safety rules are being observed and worker protection measures are being implemented at logistics centers and construction sites, and provide guidance and inspections so that work stoppages and work schedule changes can be actively carried out during peak heat hours." (고용노동부에는 “물류센터와 건설 현장 등에서 폭염 안전 5대 기본 수칙이 준수되는지와 노동자 보호 조치가 이행되는지 실태를 점검하고, 무더위 시간에는 작업 중지와 작업 시간 변경이 적극적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 지도·점검하라”고 했다.)

To the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, she said, "In order to minimize the death of farmed fish and livestock, promptly take necessary on-site measures such as deploying high-water-temperature response equipment and operating cooling systems." (해양수산부와 농식품부에는 “양식 어류와 가축의 폐사를 최소화하기 위해, 고수온 대응 장비, 냉방 장치 가동 등 현장에서 필요한 지원을 신속하게 조치하라”고 했다.)

To the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, she said, "Even if cooling demand surges due to the heat wave, frequently check the power reserve margin to ensure a stable power supply, and closely manage the water storage status of dams and reservoirs and the supply of domestic and industrial water in drought-vulnerable areas to prevent water shortages." (기후에너지환경부에는 “폭염으로 냉방 수요가 급증하더라도 전력 공급을 안정적으로 유지할 수 있도록 전력 예비율을 수시로 점검하고, 물 부족 상황이 발생하지 않도록 댐과 저수지의 용수 저장 현황 및 가뭄 취약 지역의 생활·공업용수 공급 상황을 면밀하게 관리하라”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han also urged each ministry, "Mobilize all available media, including public broadcasting, disaster text messages, electronic display boards, and village broadcasts, to promptly deliver heat wave updates to the public and provide detailed, sector-specific heat wave preparedness action guidelines." (한 총리는 또 각 부처에 “공영방송, 재난 문자, 전광판, 마을 방송 등 가용한 매체를 모두 동원해 국민에게 폭염 상황을 신속히 전달하고, 소관별로 구체적인 폭염 대비 행동 요령을 상세히 알리라”고 당부했다.)

item.title: 'Ethics Committee Referral' Remarks Fly at DP Convention..."Judge Factional Actors" "Refer Shincheonji" (‘윤리위 제소’ 언급 오간 與 전대…“계파행위자 심판” “신천지 제소”)
item.description:
'Ethics Committee Referral' Remarks Fly at DP Convention..."Judge Factional Actors" "Refer Shincheonji" (‘윤리위 제소’ 언급 오간 與 전대…“계파행위자 심판” “신천지 제소” )

As the Democratic Party of Korea began its Aug. 17 national convention roadshow primaries on the 1st to elect new leadership, on the second day, the 2nd, party leadership contenders exchanged heated remarks, including threats to "refer each other to the Ethics Committee." (더불어민주당이 1일부터 차기 지도부 선출을 위한 8·17 전당대회 순회경선을 진행 중인 가운데, 이틀차인 2일 당권주자들간 서로 “윤리위에 제소하겠다”는 등의 막말이 오갔다.)

At the Ulsan regional roadshow primary speech held that day at the Ulsan Exhibition Convention Center, party leader candidate Kim Min-seok, targeting supreme council member candidates from the pro-Chung Chung-rae faction, said, "They all need to go through the primary, and if anything goes wrong, they all need to go to the Ethics Committee. I will refer everyone who engaged in improper factional activities during this election process to the Ethics Committee." (이날 울산전시컨벤션센터에서 진행된 울산지역 순회경선 연설에서 김민석 당대표 후보는 친정청래계 최고위원 후보들을 겨냥해 “모두 경선해야 되고, 잘못되면 모두 윤리위로 가야한다. 이번 선거 과정에서 잘못된 계파 행위를 한 사람들, 모조리 윤리위에 제소할 것”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Kim also said, "Even if they enter the leadership, I will have them face judgment by the Ethics Committee." (김 후보는 “(이들이) 지도부에 들어가더라도 윤리위에 심판을 받게 하겠다”고도 했다.)

Referencing the results of the previous day's Chungcheong region roadshow primary, Candidate Kim said, "Yesterday, on the first day of the one-member-one-vote party member sovereignty convention, in Chungcheong, the will of each and every party member, one by one, overcame the organization." He added, "Yesterday I said that even if I lost by 7% in Chungcheong, I would ultimately prevail. Thankfully, the party members delivered the win." (김 후보는 전날 충청권 순회경선 결과를 언급하면서 “어제 첫 1인1표 당원주권 전당대회 첫날 충청에서 당원주권 한분 한분 당원들 모인 뜻은 조직을 이겼다” “어제 저는 충청도에서 7%까지 져도 결국 이겨낼 것이라고 했다. 감사하게도 당원들이 이겨주셨다”라고도 했다.)

Candidate Chung Chung-rae, directly targeting Candidate Kim, said, "Candidate Kim Min-seok, who wounded the hearts of party members and endangered the party by placing it at risk of being an unconstitutional party violating Article 20 of the Constitution on the separation of religion and state—once I become party leader, I will definitely refer him to the Ethics Committee for judgment." (정청래 후보는 김 후보를 직접 겨냥해 “당원들의 가슴에 상처를 준 헌법 20조 정교분리의 위헌정당 위험에 빠뜨린 김민석 후보는 제가 당대표가 되면 반드시 윤리위에 제소해서 심판하도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Chung also said, "If there's evidence about Shincheonji, produce it. Why can't anyone even mention Shincheonji members now? I've known since 2002 when he betrayed Roh Moo-hyun and went to Chung Mong-joon." (정 후보는 “신천지 근거가 있으면 근거를 대라. 왜 지금은 신천지 신자도 얘기를 못 꺼내나. 2002년 노무현 배신하고 정몽준으로 갈 때부터 알아봤다”고도 했다.)

He also claimed that factional politics is what Candidate Kim engages in. Candidate Chung said, "Nearly all media supported Kim Min-seok, nearly all polls said Kim Min-seok would win, nearly all broadcast panels said Kim Min-seok would win, and with lawmakers flocking around making phone banks and doing all that—if they only got 0.4%, then I win." (계파정치는 김 후보가 하는 것이라고도 했다. 정 후보는 “거의 모든 언론에서 김민석 지지했고, 거의 모든 여조에서 김민석 이긴다고, 거의 모든 방송 패널에서 김민석 이긴다고 했고, 국회의원 몰려다니면서 전화방 만들고 렇게 했는데도 0.4% 줬다면 제가 이긴다”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil said, "They said they wouldn't go negative, but it's turning negative. Let's stop talking about the Shincheonji issue. After the election, when the joint investigation headquarters releases its findings, let's use that to get to the truth." (송영길 후보는 “네거티브 안 한다더니 네거티브 되고 있다. 신천지 문제 더 이상 이야기하지 말자. 선거 끝나고 나서 합수본 발표 나면 그걸 가지고 진상규명하자”고 했다.)

He also raised the issue of responsibility for the June local elections and by-elections held under Representative Chung's leadership, asking, "All the seats we held were lost, weren't they? We gave up Busan Buk-gu Gap, former lawmaker Jeon Jae-su's district. We gave up former lawmaker Park Soo-hyun's district. Wasn't Pyeongtaek originally former lawmaker Lee Byung-jin's district? Didn't we lose three of our districts to the People Power Party? We lost one to an independent—is that a victory?" (또 정 대표 체제 하에서 진행됐던 지난 6월 지방선거와 보궐선거 책임을 두고 “우리 의석이었던 곳이 다 진 거잖나. 부산 북구갑 전재수 전 의원 지역 넘겼다. 그리고 박수현 전 의원 지역 넘겼다. 평택도 원래 이병진 전 의원의 지역 아니었나. 우리 지역이었던 것을 국민의힘의 세 군데나 뺏겼던 거 아닌가. 무소속에 뺏기고, 이게 승리인가”하고 따져 물었다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party continued its roadshow primary joint speeches that morning starting in Ulsan, followed by Busan and South Gyeongsang Province. After the South Gyeongsang speech in Changwon, the results of the Yeongnam region party member voting will be announced. (한편, 민주당은 이날 오전 울산을 시작으로 부산과 경남에서 각각 순회 경선 합동 연설회를 이어간다. 창원에서 열리는 경남지역 연설회가 끝나면 영남권 권리당원 투표 결과를 발표한다.)

In the previous day's Chungcheong region (South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, Daejeon, Sejong) primary party member vote, Candidate Kim received 45.05% of the vote, leading Candidate Chung (44.61%) by 0.44 percentage points. (김 후보는 전날 충청권(충남·충북·대전·세종) 경선의 당원 투표에서 45.05% 득표율로 정 후보(44.61%)를 0.44%포인트 차이로 앞섰다.)

item.title: "Someone Who Abandoned Roh and Attacked Lee" — Jeong Cheong-rae's Direct Hit and Kim Min-seok's Response (“盧 버렸고, 李 공격했던 사람” 정청래의 직격에 김민석 말은)
item.description:
"Someone Who Abandoned Roh and Attacked Lee" — Jeong Cheong-rae's Direct Hit and Kim Min-seok's Response (“盧 버렸고, 李 공격했던 사람” 정청래의 직격에 김민석 말은)

At the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention joint speech rally held in Busan, where the late former President Roh Moo-hyun built his political foundation, party leadership contenders once again clashed over who represents the true legacy of Roh Moo-hyun's spirit. (고(故) 노무현 전 대통령이 정치적 기반을 다진 부산에서 열린 더불어민주당 전당대회 합동연설회에서 당권 주자들은 노무현 정신의 적통(嫡統)을 놓고 다시 맞붙었다.)

The debate centered on what stance each candidate took during the internal party strife in 2002, when a "candidate unification council" was formed ahead of the presidential election demanding Roh Moo-hyun's withdrawal as a candidate. Candidate Kim Min-seok at that time participated in founding the National Integration 21 party, led by former lawmaker Chung Mong-joon. (2002년 대선을 앞두고 노무현 전 대통령의 후보 사퇴를 요구하는 ‘후보단일화협의회(후단협)’가 만들어져 당내 내분이 있었을 때 각자 어떤 입장을 취했는지 따지는 식이었다. 김민석 후보는 당시 정몽준 전 의원의 당인 국민통합21 창당에 참여했다.)

At the Busan joint speech rally that day, candidate Jeong Cheong-rae said, "When Chung Mong-joon abandoned Roh Moo-hyun, we were stamping our feet in desperation, sending texts, making calls, and pleading for votes. Whose side was Kim Min-seok on that night?" (이날 부산 합동연설회에서 정청래 후보는 “정몽준이 노무현을 버렸다고 했을 때 우리는 발을 동동 구르며 문자하고 전화하고 투표해 달라고 외쳤다. 그날 밤 김민석은 누구 편이었느냐”고 말했다.)

Jeong also said, "The late President Roh once said, 'Do you want to be treated as a person? Then you must have loyalty.'" He added, "Four years ago, lawmaker Kim Min-seok blamed Lee Jae-myung for the local election defeat and attacked him for ruining the elections due to his personal judgment. Now, four years later, he is attacking Jeong Cheong-rae." (또 정 후보는 “노 전 대통령께서 ‘사람 대접 받고 싶은가, 그러면 의리가 있어야 된다’라고 했다”며 “4년 전 지방선거 패배 책임을 이재명에게 돌리고 이재명의 사적 판단 때문에 지방선거를 망쳤다고 공격했던 김민석 의원이 4년 후에는 정청래를 공격하고 있다”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok countered, saying, "After the candidate unification in 2002, former President Kim Dae-jung gave me a guiding principle of 'retreat and consolidation,' telling me to 'polish your inner strength.'" (김민석 후보는 이에 대해 “김대중 전 대통령은 2002년 후보 단일화 이후 저에게 ‘내공을 잘 닦으라’는 퇴수(退守)의 화두를 주셨다”고 반박했다.)

Kim said, "Former lawmaker Seo Gap-won, who knows the candidate unification process well, is currently helping me. Regarding what Kim Min-seok did in 2002 — who was not part of the candidate unification council — he relayed that when I visited Bongha in 2008 as a supreme council member, President Roh said, 'The historical matter was settled by the choice of the delegates.'" (김 후보는 “후보 단일화 과정을 알고 있는 서갑원 전 의원께서 최근에 저를 돕고 계신데, 후단협이 아니었던 김민석이 2002년에 했던 행동에 대해서, ’2008년 최고위원이 돼서 봉하를 찾았을 때 노 대통령께서는 대의원들의 선택으로 역사적 정리가 되었다’고 말씀해 주셨다*고 전했다.)

He added, "To Busan, the son of Busan, Kim Min-seok — once a son, always a son — and to the Democratic Party that would embrace the prodigal son who has returned, I say this: Kim Min-seok has returned as the Democratic Party's son, the party's rightful heir has come back." (또 “부산의 아들 김민석, 한 번 아들은 영원한 아들, 돌아온 탕아를 안아주시는 그런 부산과 민주당에게 말씀드린다. 김민석이 민주당의 아들이, 민주당의 적자가 돌아왔다”고 했다.)

Among the supreme council member candidates, proxy attacks on behalf of both sides continued. Earlier, at the Ulsan joint speech rally, pro-Lee candidate Kim Yong raised the issue of responsibility for the June 3 local elections, targeting Jeong by criticizing, "A politician who does not take responsibility has no qualifications." Candidate Im Mi-ae said, "The leader of the ruling party must meet the opposition leader, talk, compromise, and endure even when it's dirty and distasteful, while persuading," indirectly criticizing Jeong for being passive about meeting with the opposition leader. (최고위원 후보들 사이에서도 양측을 대리하는 공방이 이어졌다. 앞서 울산 합동연설회에서 친명계 김용 후보는 6·3 지방선거 책임론을 거론하며 정 후보를 겨냥해 “책임을 지지 않는 정치인은 자격이 없다”고 비판했다. 임미애 후보는 “집권 여당 대표는 야당 대표를 만나 대화하고 타협하고, 더럽고 아니꼽더라도 참으면서 설득해야 한다”며 야당 대표와의 회동에 소극적이었던 정 후보를 우회적으로 비판했다.)

In response, pro-Jeong candidate Lee Seong-yun attacked, saying, "Prime Minister Kim Min-seok — during his time as prime minister, he established a prosecution reform task force, spent taxpayers' money for a year, and what on earth did he actually accomplish?" Candidate Han Min-soo also targeted Kim, saying, "The party, government, and presidential office coordinated all matters as one team — if there were problems, why didn't the then-prime minister say a single word?" (반면 친정청래계 이성윤 후보는 “김민석 총리는 총리 시절 검찰개혁추진단을 만들어 1년 동안 혈세를 쓰고도 도대체 무엇을 했느냐”고 공격했다. 한민수 후보도 “당·정·청이 원팀으로 모든 사안을 조율했는데 문제가 있었다면 왜 당시 총리는 한마디도 하지 않았느냐”고 김 후보를 겨냥했다.)
